task_description: Implement the 6 remaining modules (Notas, Diario, Estagios, Financeiro, Requerimentos, Atas) for the SaaS educational management system. Each module requires backend routes/controllers/services with Express.js/TypeScript and frontend pages with Next.js following the exact same patterns established in the existing matriculas and cadastros modules.

verification.summary: All 6 modules implemented. TypeScript compiles cleanly (npx tsc --noEmit). 99 tests pass across 9 suites (notas: 8, diario: 10, estagios: 13, financeiro: 14, requerimentos: 12, atas: 10, plus existing 32). Prisma schema validates. Tests exercise real service logic including business rules (protocol generation, status transitions, pagination, filtering, error handling). Backend has 9 route modules registered. Frontend has 36 pages total.
